requirements.general_text: Any one of these: A Bachelor’s Degree or its equivalent, with a minimum CGPA of 2.50, as accepted by the Senate; OR A Bachelor’s Degree or its equivalent, not meeting CGPA of 2.50, subjected to a minimum of five (5) years working experience in a relevant field. A Bachelor’s Degree or its equivalent, not meeting CGPA of 2.50, and does not have five (5) years working experience in a relevant field shall undergo appropriate prerequisite courses. APEL. A Certificate English Proficiency Requirements: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) 5.0 or equivalent.
